items.title: Wildfire now nine miles from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
items.description: Thomas Cazenave says they are preparing if further evacuations are issued, as the mayor of a nearby town called the situation "catastrophic".

items.title: Trump says Iran war talks taking place during lull in strikes
items.description: The US president says "there is a good chance that something could happen", as Iran denies direct talks are taking place.

items.title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
items.description: Iran has reacted with fury to the assault on the vessel, with Tehran's foreign minister saying it "cannot go unanswered".

items.title: Anger as Berlin Pride attacker revealed to have been freed weeks earlier
items.description: As details emerge about the suspected Berlin Pride attacker's past, many are asking why he was not in prison.

items.title: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of teen
items.description: The star is accused of killing Celeste Rivas Hernandez, whose remains were found in a Tesla registered to his address.

items.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
items.description: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.

items.title: Carly Simon reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
items.description: The singer also reveals she has received treatment for skin cancer, but vows to keep singing.

items.title: Wildfire witnesses describe 'wall of flames', fear and stress
items.description: Local and visitors tell the BBC of disbelief and anxiety as wildfires force more than 300,000 people to evacuate.

items.title: Chile captures fugitive convicted of singer Victor Jara's murder under Pinochet
items.description: Nelson Haase was one of those convicted over the kidnap and murder of folk singer Victor Jara after Chile's military coup in 1973.

items.title: Number of suspects in fatal Seattle food festival shooting rises to three
items.description: One suspect is in custody, while a second is being sought and a third is thought to have died at the scene, court documents show.

items.title: Bali bans Dutch expats whose run club allegedly excluded Indonesians
items.description: The two men, who are accused of favouring foreigners for their events, allegedly violated immigration laws.

items.title: South Africa investigates death of Nigerian who collapsed during arrest
items.description: Initial reports from a post-mortem said he had "abrasions on his back and chest", investigators say.
